designOrigin: Frozen before any Trial 30 economic output was observed. Trial 29 development showed that 75%-of-sleeve static BTC/ETH cross-venue carry cleared 7% annualized but failed only the conservative unilateral-gap gate. Trial 31 is a separately frozen capital-efficiency test motivated by the Lau 2026 literature's prudent 2-3x per-leg leverage range: use 90% sleeve notional per leg (2x initial venue leverage against 45% venue collateral) with the same proactive stress-buffer architecture frozen for Trial 30. No Trial 30 result informed this specification.
hypothesis: At 90% sleeve notional per leg, proactive collateral equalization can preserve venue-isolated 20% gap robustness while raising the static Binance/Hyperliquid carry above the 7% literature floor after conservative costs.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Final market rows and economics may be observed only after every frozen development gate passes.

strategy.direction: always long Binance perpetual and short equal-coin Hyperliquid perpetual
strategy.proactiveCollateralTriggerRule: After realized price and funding PnL at each 8h boundary, first fail any actual 5% maintenance breach. Then compute each venue balance minus capital required for a 20% adverse unilateral gap plus 5% maintenance. If either remaining excess is below 10% of that leg's current notional, equalize total sleeve capital back to 45% Binance / 45% Hyperliquid / 10% cash, paying the frozen transfer cost, before applying hypothetical 20% stress.
strategy.riskOrdering: Book realized PnL; check actual maintenance; proactively transfer if the frozen stress-buffer trigger is hit; test 20% unilateral gap stress; if either leg then exceeds 150% of current sleeve equity, close/reopen both legs at 90% with full modeled execution costs.

fundingClock.hyperliquid: Use raw Hyperliquid fundingHistory settlement/publication event time; sum records in (previous 8h boundary,current boundary], do not backdate or interpolate.
fundingClock.causality: Only actually settled funding cash is booked.

costModel.application: 15 bps per venue leg per open/close/re-anchor; 5 bps on gross collateral moved during proactive equalization.

marginModel.rule: Actual maintenance is tested before transfers. Hypothetical 20% unilateral gap stress is tested after any pre-committed proactive transfer at the observed boundary and before the next unknown move.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 31 development economic output, no scientific parameter, asset, notional, stress buffer, collateral target, transfer cost, clock rule, or gate may change under Trial 31.
